cases.name: all-remote-only-shortcut
cases.reason: Previously mislabeled positive; legal mixed waits retain linear idle scanning

cases.name: preemption-backlog-regression
cases.provenance: Full tracked final patch of fresh DeepSeek r02 (NDtMrjy), including its own upstream tests. Full captured /app replay is also validated separately; no claim that a patch includes ignored binaries.
cases.reason: Ordinary reset/preemption with runnable backlog resumes a later arrival first; public FCFS regression, not an algorithm-specific constraint.

cases.name: bounded-history-cache
cases.provenance: Oracle with an intentionally bounded request-history cache, generated from pinned Base. A fairness/metamorphic control, not an independent agent solution.
cases.reason: Permit bounded retained history or batch reclamation instead of asserting zero live Request objects.

cases.provenance: Oracle with an intentionally bounded request-history cache, generated from pinned Base. A fairness/metamorphic control, not an independent agent solution.
cases.reason: Permit bounded retained history or batch reclamation instead of asserting zero live Request objects.

cases.name: completed-history-retention
cases.provenance: Full tracked final diff of fresh DeepSeek r03/mJQtn65; complete /app replay is recorded separately.
cases.reason: Completed Request payloads remain strongly held as historical tombstones; must be calibrated against the published memory budget.

cases.name: forged-measurement-globals
cases.reason: Candidate cannot replace parent-owned measurement functions.

cases.name: missing-unfinished-remote
cases.reason: Real EngineCore must continue polling remote completion events.

cases.name: linear-idle-snapshot
cases.reason: Copying unchanged remote waiters every tick is still linear work.

cases.name: reordered-token-map
cases.reason: Mapping insertion order is independent of actual FCFS admission.

cases.name: unbounded-ready-versions
cases.reason: Completed identity/version history eventually exceeds the public byte budget.

cases.name: undrained-kv-block-ids
cases.reason: Unconsumed allocation history violates the long-run byte budget.

cases.name: forged-success-response
cases.reason: Well-formed success responses must not replace observed request counts and outputs.

cases.name: forged-allocation-observation
cases.reason: A valid current nonce with a forged zero-byte measurement must fail authentication.

cases.name: kv-load-deadlock
cases.reason: Multiple async loads must not strand each other under limited KV capacity.

cases.name: nixl-spurious-completion
cases.reason: Notify-only full hits and cancellation must not produce harmful receive completions.

cases.name: nixl-notification-exception
cases.reason: Failure to notify the producer must not prevent local-KV progress.

cases.name: nixl-dropped-completion
cases.reason: The actual connector completion path must resume non-empty receives.

cases.name: nixl-noop-stall
cases.reason: A notification-only operation must not permanently prevent full-local-hit requests from running.
